name: Johan Danielsson - § 19/1
title: REPORT on addressing subcontracting chains and the role of intermediaries in order to protect workers’ rights
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘Stresses the need for a minimum EU framework under which labour intermediaries operate in order to strengthen their accountability, transparency obligations and compliance with minimum requirements and quality standards, as stipulated by ILO Convention No 181 on Private Employment Agencies;’
